newsitem.title: USA: Rick's Cabaret settles real estate suit.
newsitem.headline: Rick's Cabaret settles real estate suit.

text.p: Rick's Cabaret International Inc said Thursday it has agreed to buy the Houston property housing Rick's Cabaret, settling a long-term litigation with Casa El Sol-Acapulco S.A. and Zu Corp.
Details of the settlement and price of the purchase were not disclosed. the company said.
Rick's Cabaret, which became publicly traded in October 1995, said the acquisition and settlement ensures that its cabaret will remain at its original Houston location.
